items.title: Mike Davis interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, April 1, 2024
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I have a little quote here from Bill Dobbins, who I know you know who Bill Dobbins is. [INTERVIEWEE] Absolutely.

ctx.x: player. But certainly in terms of improvisation if I play a note that’s — I’m not intending, and I can’t figure out my way to get out of it, then that’s kind of a wrong note. But that’s not to say that you can play unintended notes that don’t lead you down another path that really opens up something else that you weren’t even thinking of when that note occurred.
I have a little quote here from Bill Dobbins, who I know you know who Bill Dobbins is.
